cues.meaning: Gap looks unanswered / partially answered — knowledge missing.
Item is a candidate investigation target (functional curiosity cue).
Partial/caveated gap or low answerability — risk of stuck confusion.
High surprise axis with an open gap — unexpectedness signal.
Related literature ≠ answered, or surprise+gap — incongruity framing.
High neglectedness — prefer under-explored over over-covered topics.

disclaimer: Epistemic cues are UX annotations for investigation framing (incongruity / information-gap / confusion-risk) — NOT claims that this system feels emotions.
note: Epistemic cues annotate investigation framing. This software does not feel emotions.
